name: weather-app
description: Cel-shaded weather app. The app itself needs no build step; npm is only used for tests and to rebuild the slim anime.js bundle.

scripts.build:vendor: esbuild vendor/anime-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --banner:js="/* anime.js 4.5.0 (MIT) https://animejs.com - only the parts this app uses. Rebuild: npm run build:vendor */" --outfile=vendor/anime.slim.min.js
